free_basis_failure.ambient: Fundamental group F2 of the endpoint disk with two standard round holes; compatible generators x,y.
free_basis_failure.arbitrary_accesses: First access winds y; second winds x, giving yxy^-1 and xyx^-1.
free_basis_failure.proof: Original x,y generate S3, whereas both changed loops map to the same transposition and generate only its order-two subgroup. Thus changed loops do not generate F2, although each is still a positive meridian conjugate and H1 is unchanged.

longitude_and_algorithm_failure.geometry: Trivial one-string product exterior P×I; blackboard parallel beta, compatible accesses a0,a1 with a0 beta a1^-1=1. Change only a0 to mu a0.
longitude_and_algorithm_failure.repaired_evaluation: H0=1+X,H1=1,k=0,R=0 gives Lambda=1+X; inverse variable substitution is the identity.
